title: A word index
description:
Build an index of which lines each word appears on.

```
cat: 1, 3
dog: 2
down: 2
sat: 1, 2
the: 1, 2, 3
```
hints: `line.toLowerCase().split("[^a-z]+")` gives the words; skip the empty strings it can make (lesson 4.02).
requirements: Use a `TreeMap<String, TreeSet<Integer>>` so words and line numbers come out sorted.
Words are lower case and contain only letters.
`computeIfAbsent` adds a new set the first time a word is seen.
stretch: Leave out words that appear on every line.
